name: Influencer Collaboration ROI
query:
SELECT
  ibc.influencer_name as "Influencer:Data:150",
  ibc.platform as "Platform:Data:100",
  ibc.collection as "Collection:Link/Fashion Collection Master:150",
  ibc.agreed_amount as "Agreed Amount:Currency:120",
  ibc.workflow_state as "Status:Data:100"
FROM `tabInfluencer Brand Collaboration` ibc
ORDER BY ibc.agreed_amount DESC
